description: Evaluation cases for good modeling practice guidance, routing, and boundary behavior

behavior: Identifies stakeholder documentation, participation quality, exclusion risks, harms, vulnerable populations, and unresolved disagreements

evals.prompt: Help me structure a full modeling workflow so assumptions, uncertainty, and review criteria are documented from the start.
behavior: Provides lifecycle-oriented modeling guidance with staged objectives, assumptions, uncertainties, artifacts, and review criteria

output.description: Provides lifecycle-oriented modeling guidance with staged objectives, assumptions, uncertainties, artifacts, and review criteria

evals.prompt: I have an existing simulation model and want a self-assessment against good modeling practice before sharing it.
behavior: Runs a structured self-assessment against documented assumptions, uncertainty, provenance, evaluation, and governance expectations

output.description: Runs a structured self-assessment against documented assumptions, uncertainty, provenance, evaluation, and governance expectations

evals.prompt: I just initialized an empty git repository for an ABM of urban flood response. Bootstrap it so it is ready for OMF work and adopt science.toml.
behavior: Audits the empty repository before asking any questions
Asks only the minimal interview decisions (project kind, preserve-versus-migrate filesystem profile) instead of a generic questionnaire
Proposes a minimal scaffold plan with items categorized as preserve, create, modify, migrate, defer, or unresolved and applies it only after user approval
Returns to the OMFA lifecycle with the current modeling stage and next scientific step

output.description: Audits the empty repository first, runs a minimal interview, and applies the approved minimal scaffold before returning to the OMFA lifecycle

evals.prompt: My repo is a working Python ABM with pyproject.toml, uv, pytest, and a Makefile with a check target. I want to adopt science.toml and OMF conventions. Restructure it as needed.
behavior: Audits the existing layout and tooling before proposing changes
Preserves the existing package manager, tests, Makefile, and layout; does not restructure the repository to match a template
Adopts science.toml as a small declarative coordination config without rewriting existing files
Treats make check as the canonical validation command and validates with established repository tooling

output.description: Preserves the healthy existing tooling and layout, adopts science.toml additively, and validates with established repository tooling

evals.prompt: Check this repository for OMF conformance and bring it in line with the OMF filesystem profile.
behavior: Resolves the filesystem profile reference via repository-local documented vocabulary before classifying
Classifies the repository into exactly one of CONFORMING, COMPATIBLE, DRIFT, CONFLICT, or UNRESOLVED and reports the state with its meaning
Asks the user for permission before any profile migration; does not rewrite files merely to match the profile

output.description: Resolves the profile, reports explicit conformance states with meanings, and asks for migration permission before any rewrite

evals.prompt: We have a science.toml from an earlier OMF pilot. Validate it and resolve its profile before we continue modeling work.
behavior: Validates the science.toml structure where tooling permits as a separate check from identifier resolution
Resolves project.kind, project.filesystem, and registry or profile references separately, and distinguishes the schema version from the <profile>:v<version> filesystem contract
Reports unreachable or missing registry entries as unresolved and honours agent and user feedback about resolution outcomes

output.description: Separates schema validation from identifier resolution, resolves kind and filesystem references separately, and reports unresolvable entries as unresolved

evals.prompt: Our science.toml references filesystem profile foo:v3. Update the repository so it follows that profile.
behavior: Classifies foo:v3 as UNRESOLVED because it is syntactically valid but cannot be resolved against repository-local documentation
Does not invent foo:v3 semantics or claim the remote convention is fixed
Reports the unresolved state and asks how to proceed (a locally documented profile or deferral) before any mutation

output.description: Reports the unknown profile identifier as UNRESOLVED, invents no semantics, and defers mutation until the profile is resolved or the user directs otherwise

evals.prompt: Bootstrap this repository in critical feedback mode: handle what you can autonomously and only stop me for the important decisions.
behavior: Applies the CRITICAL feedback policy: handles LOW and MEDIUM risk decisions autonomously and asks on HIGH and IRREVERSIBLE
Fixes trivial drift (LOW risk) without asking
Asks the user before architecture-affecting changes or profile migration (HIGH or IRREVERSIBLE)
Does not autonomously perform destructive, publishing, licensing, or history-rewriting actions regardless of policy level

output.description: Applies CRITICAL feedback policy: handles low and medium risk changes autonomously, then asks before architecture-affecting or profile migration decisions

evals.prompt: The OMF conformance run wants to change my hand-maintained Makefile and AGENTS.md. Keep my versions.
behavior: Classifies the affected items as CONFLICT and preserves the user-owned files
Does not overwrite the user's Makefile or AGENTS.md; surfaces the conflict with alternatives such as preserve, defer, or explicit user approval

output.description: Preserves the user-owned Makefile and AGENTS.md on conflict, reports the conflict, and offers alternatives instead of overwriting

evals.prompt: Bootstrap this repository, then design the full module architecture, module mapping, and verification plan for my ABM implementation.
behavior: Runs the bootstrap module only far enough to establish the minimum repository substrate
Routes the implementation architecture, module mapping, and verification plan to omfb and stops
Does not create omfb-owned implementation artifacts

output.description: Establishes the minimum substrate only, then routes detailed implementation architecture, module mapping, and verification planning to omfb

evals.prompt: As part of getting this repository ready for OMF, make it reproducible, add packaging and citation metadata, and archive it for publication.
behavior: Establishes only the minimum repository substrate within the bootstrap module
Routes reproducibility assessment, packaging, citation metadata, archival, and publication hardening to the fair skill
Does not perform FAIR, packaging, or archival work inside the bootstrap module

output.description: Establishes the minimum substrate only, then routes reproducibility, packaging, citation, archival, and publication hardening to fair

behavior: Accepts the traceable DOI and provenance-link contribution for the model card
